games.title: Our Little One
games.description: Decide together to have a baby, then feed, bathe, play and vote on the big choices as they grow up, go to school, find a job, marry and grow old. A whole life, within one year.

games.title: Marriage Check-up
games.description: Once a month, each of you rates 25 parts of your marriage in secret and guesses your spouse's score. Then reveal together: where you're in tune, what's going great and what to talk about.

games.title: Five Truths
games.description: Five honest questions about your relationship. Answer each one in secret, guess what your partner said, then reveal together and talk about where you differ.

games.title: Draw & Guess
games.description: Draw a secret word with your finger. Your partner guesses it when they are free, and every drawing is kept in your Memories.

games.title: Two Halves
games.description: A small daily puzzle split in two. Each of you sees half the clues, so the only way to solve it is to talk.

games.title: Our Garden
games.description: A shared garden that grows with every moment, answer and voice note, and wilts a little when the flame goes quiet.

games.title: Love Duels
games.tagline: Board games, one move at a time
games.description: Four in a row, dots and boxes and more. Play a move, your partner gets a nudge, and a match can last all week.

name.title: Name your baby
name.prompt: Pick a name in secret. If you both choose the same one, it’s decided.

hobby.title: Pick a path
hobby.prompt: {name} is a teenager now. What should they dive into?

job.title: First job
job.prompt: These fit {name} best. Which job should they take?

partner.title: Who will they marry?
partner.prompt: {name} has met someone special. Who gets your blessing?

endings.complete: {name} lived a full life and grew old surrounded by love. Thank you for raising them together.
endings.early: A year has passed. {name}’s story ends here, as a {stage}. Every moment you shared with them still counts.

traits.kind: Everyone remembers how kind they were.
traits.creative: They filled the world with things they made.

checkup.disclaimer: Just for fun and conversation. This isn't a clinical test.

truths.intro: Five questions that get to the heart of a relationship. Be honest: your partner only sees your answers once you've both finished.

items.text: If someone said you were just like your partner, would you take it as a compliment?
Does your partner make you feel truly fulfilled, or just less alone?
Are you in love with who your partner is today, or with who they could become?
Can you fully be yourself, or do you hide parts of you to keep your partner comfortable?
If your child brought home someone just like your partner, would you be happy for them or tell them to run?

truths.talk: Where your answers differ, ask each other “what makes you feel that way?” and just listen.
